attempts.text:
**The spine starts at the origin.** Columns 0 to 5, `dnaA`, `dnaN`, `recF`, `gyrB`, `yidB` and `yidA`, are spine columns carried by 92 to 99.9% of genomes, and the least in a region of plasticity of the whole window: 0 to 0.5% of calls. The model names 93 to 100% of genes there, fewest at `yidB`, named 93%, where it also hesitates most in the stretch, 0.43 bits.

**The first fork is at `yidX`**, column 6, named in 72% of calls. Then the `dgo` operon, [[galactonate catabolism]], variable columns 7 to 11, carried by 84 to 88% of genomes, in a region of plasticity in 90 to 99.9% of calls. The model still names 72 to 99% there, mean 90%.

**A spine follows**, `cbrA` to `yidE`, carried by 95 to 97% of genomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.1 to 0.4% of calls. The model names 27 to 99%, mean 84%, fewest at `ibpB`, named 27%; no column here hesitates more than 0.19 bits.

**Then 62 fork and variable columns**, columns 18 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 99.7% of calls. The model names 67 to 99%, mean 88%, fewest at column 75, named 67%, and hesitates most at column 45 (`yicJ`), 1.38 bits, in a region of plasticity in 39% of calls. Through columns 45 to 52 a second branch of 8 families, in 11% of genomes, runs parallel, [[sugar transport and aldolase genes]].

**The window ends in the `waa` locus**, [[lipopolysaccharide core biosynthesis]]: `waaA` in 38% of genomes, then `rfaQ`, `waaG`, `rfaP`, `waaO`, `rfaC` and `rfaF`, down to 9 to 27%. Across the window the model names 89% of genes, 0.41 bits on average; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.83 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 94%.

label: dnaA
facts:
WINDOW: the dnaA window: 80 columns from dnaA (column 0) in its direction, in all 2,002 genomes of the PanGBank E. coli pangenome; 130,837 calls of the model, each on a genome's real proteins. 1,359 of the 2,002 genomes have all 80 columns on one contig; in the others the window stops earlier, at a contig end.
TERMS: share: genomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of genomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every genome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other genomes (genes inserted upstream push it out, or a contig ends); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.41 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 82,603 calls, named 95%, 0.16 bits; shell 46,278 calls, named 80%, 0.73 bits; cloud 1,956 calls, named 29%, 3.34 bits. Outside an RGP 89,567 calls, named 94%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 41,270 calls, named 78%, 0.83 bits. Columns: 12 spine, 14 fork, 54 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.83 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 94%); 41,270 of the 130,837 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 45 (yicJ) 1.38 bits, RGP 39%; column 44 (setC) 1.09 bits, RGP 46%; column 46 (yicI) 0.94 bits, RGP 51%. The 18 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.35 bits on average; the other 61 columns: named 90%, 0.43 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 6-11 (fork and variable columns), RGP 90-99.9%; the least: columns 0-5 (spine), RGP 0-0.5%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of genomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-5 (6 columns) spine: share 92-99.9%, all P, RGP 0-0.5%. Genes: dnaA "chromosomal replication initiator p…", dnaN, recF, gyrB, yidB "YidB family protein", yidA "sugar-phosphatase". named 93-100% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (yidB), named 93%, 0.43 bits.
2. columns 6-11 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 90-99.9%. named 72-99% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 6, named 72%; most hesitant at column 11, 0.41 bits.
   6 fork: yidX S 70% "protein YidX"; also "hypothetical protein" S 25%
   columns 7-11 variable, share 84-88%, all S: dgoR 88%, dgoK 85%, dgoA 87%, dgoD "galactonate dehydratase" 86%, dgoT 84%
3. columns 12-17 (6 columns) spine: share 95-97%, all P, RGP 0.1-0.4%. Genes: cbrA, yidR "DUF3748 domain-containing protein", yidQ "YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein", ibpA "small heat shock chaperone IbpA", ibpB, yidE "putative transporter". named 27-99% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 16 (ibpB), named 27%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 12 (cbrA)).
4. columns 18-79 (62 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0.2-99.7%. named 67-99% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 75, named 67%; most hesitant at column 45, 1.38 bits.
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 45-52, a parallel path that some genomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its genomes, share 11%, all S; the branch's families: "BglG family transcription antiterminator", "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIB", "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIC", "class II fructose-bisphosphate aldolase", "ketose-bisphosphate aldolase", "ROK family protein", "D-lyxose/D-mannose family sugar isomera…"
   18 variable: yidP S 77% "GntR family transcriptional regulat…"
   19 variable: glvC S 82%
   20 fork: yidL S 79% "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…"; also glvA S 43%
   columns 21-33 variable, share 66-89%, 9 P, 4 S: yidK "solute:sodium symporter family tran…" 76%, yidJ "sulfatase-like hydrolase/transferase" 77%, yidI "protein YidI" 66%, yidH "YidH family protein" 89%, yidG "DUF202 domain-containing protein" 89%, yidF "radical SAM protein" 89%, emrD 89%, ysdE "protein YsdE" 87%, tisB 80%, ivbL 88%, ilvB "acetolactate synthase large subunit" 88%, ilvN 88%, uhpA 88%
   34 fork: uhpB P 87% "signal transduction histidine-prote…"; also "hypothetical protein" S 13%
   35 fork: uhpC P 87%; also "hypothetical protein" S 11%
   columns 36-42 variable, share 78-87%, all P: uhpT 87%, adeD "adenine deaminase" 86%, adeQ 84%, yicN "DUF1198 domain-containing protein" 86%, nepI 84%, yicS "protein YicS" 80%, nlpA 78%
   43 fork: yicL P 79% "carboxylate/amino acid/amine transp…"; also "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 24%, "IS1-like element IS1A family transposase" S 16%
   44 fork: setC S 61%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system RelE/Par…" S 22%
   45 fork: yicJ P 60% "glycoside-pentoside-hexuronide fami…"; also "DUF4942 domain-containing protein" S 11%
   46 fork: yicI P 58% "alpha-xylosidase"; also iatC S 15%, "DUF957 domain-containing protein" S 11%
